goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09). v27's 10M/384 budget was PROVEN non-convergent at 2.2631 BPC (run w7to9wg0, hardy-aardvark-18, iter-20) because ~12x fewer training steps; 30M/96 converges. The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~30.0 min (1802.9s fit) to 1.79396 BPC @ E40 at re-locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget
current_best.notes: Iter-23 (kernel v31) = token-decoder capacity probe on the winning lever. v29->v31 token_dec_layers 3->4->5 with dim_ff 256->384->512 (QK-norm on) moved BPC 1.8759 -> 1.8483 -> 1.79396. v30 (chunk decoder scale-up 8->12L/2560) REGRESSED 1.8483->1.8749 and was reverted in v31. The token decoder (the BPC metric surface) is the current bottleneck, not the PerPos chunk decoder. Progression (30M/96 re-locked budget): 1.8869 (v22) -> 1.8833 (window-warmup) -> [1.9049 bigram regression, reverted] -> [v25 QK-norm build ERROR] -> 1.87799 (v28 QK-norm green) -> 1.8759 (v29) -> 1.8483 (v29 token-dec 4L) -> [1.8749 v30 chunk 12L regression] -> 1.79396 (v31 token-dec 5L/512).

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-24 (v32, next): CONTINUE the winning token-decoder capacity lever. v31 (5L/512ff) delivered 1.79396. Probes: token_dec_layers 5->6 / token_dec_dim_ff 512->768, or sweep nhead {2,4,8} + dropout {0.0,0.05,0.1} at fixed 5L/512. Every recent BPC win came from token-dec scaling; chunk-dec scaling regressed.
